name: Gold Seal Private Pilot Ground School
summary: A year of online training with CFI email and phone support, and a cheap renewal.
priceLabel: $229 for the first year, then $60 a year
accessTerm: One year; additional annual enrollments are $60
endorsementNote: Says a downloadable PDF endorsement signed and dated by an FAA flight instructor is issued on completion.
guarantee: Says it reimburses the cost of the exam, up to $175, if you complete the program and do not pass the FAA knowledge test on the first try (taken within 7 days of the final exam), plus a 90 day full refund if you have not completed the course.
includes: Unlimited randomized quizzes through a quizzing and review engine
Email and phone support from a CFI
Private Pilot syllabus, library and a signed Certificate of Completion
watchOut: Access is one year, not lifetime; comparison articles list this course as one year or lifetime, at $179 to $299.
The first-try guarantee needs the exam taken within 7 days of the final exam.
